title: Check the starting substring
description: Write a function `starts_with_check(text, prefix)` that returns whether `text` starts with `prefix`.
hints: text.startswith(prefix) checks the beginning of the string directly - it's clearer and safer than slicing text[:len(prefix)] and comparing it to prefix by hand.
expected_behavior: Returns True if text starts with prefix, False otherwise.
explanation: startswith() is both clearer and safer than manual slicing - it doesn't need a separate length check for a prefix longer than the string itself.
